pledge: I will never blow up an account again. Fixed size, hard stop, no averaging down, every trade.

items: Write the plan before entry: ticker, entry, exit level, target, size.
Fixed risk per trade (5% of account, stepped up only at Friday milestones).
Hard stop: done for the day after the 2nd loss or 2x risk lost. No 'one more' trade.
One entry, fixed size. No averaging down, ever.
No entries 9:30-10:00. Wait for a higher low after 10:00.
15-minute time stop: not green in 15 minutes, close it.
No overnight or weekend holds on losing short-dated options; no holds into earnings.
Premium in one trade never over 25% of the account.
Log every trade the same day.
$500 risk per trade (R = net / $500).
Daily stop: 2 losses or $1,000 down, whichever comes first.
Size caps: 25 MNQ / 10 MES.
No adds to a position.
No entries 9:30-10:00.
15-minute time stop.

goals: Pass the prop evaluations and get paid: Topstep and Apex, one account at a time, rules first.
Rebuild the small IBKR account steadily through fixed-risk trades. Size up only at milestones.
Keep the retirement account steady: long-term, no trading it on emotion.
Long term: become a millionaire through disciplined, repeatable trading.

lessons.title: Revenge, averaging down, no stop
lessons.text: Overnight ES call trades, then a 3 AM revenge re-entry. QQQ 713C bought at 9:31 (avoid window), averaged down and held to -80%. A stop would have exited about an hour earlier. A -50R day right after a +24R day: one undisciplined day erased two good ones.

lessons.title: Green day, bad habits
lessons.text: Strong day (+24R, 16W/2L), but 8 of 18 trades had adds. Winning while averaging down reinforces the habit that blows accounts.

lessons.title: One trade, whole daily limit
lessons.text: Hit the Topstep daily limit in a single MNQ trade by averaging down. No adds means no adds, on futures too.

lessons.title: One trade = most of the account
lessons.text: A single 0DTE call averaged down three times (1.47 -> 1.19) with ~88% of the account in premium, closed near zero: -16.8R in one trade.

lessons.title: Account blown
lessons.text: No game plan, off-schedule trades, oversized premium. -57R day ended the account. This is why the pledge exists.

lessons.title: Green at the 2nd loss, then one more
lessons.text: 15W/2L and green at the 2nd loss, then an SPXW trade after the limit averaged from 2 to 20 lots turned the day red (-26R). The hard stop was added because of this day.

items.note: Overnight revenge trades and averaging down. No trading the night after a big loss.
